info.title: App API
info.description: Built-in labels and descriptions follow the `Accept-Language` request header (`en-US` or `zh-CN`, English by default). Fixed codes in responses (statuses, categories, actions, roles, module keys…) are enums: map them to text in the frontend

get.summary: Current user

delete.summary: Delete my account (sign in again first; nothing paid may be left)
delete.description: Needs a session from the last 10 minutes (403 REAUTH_REQUIRED). Refused for staff accounts (STAFF_ACCOUNT) and while balance, commission or paid subscriptions are left (409 ACCOUNT_HAS_BILLING, details say what). Sign the user out afterwards

put.summary: Upload my avatar (raw PNG, JPEG or WebP body, up to 2 MB)
put.description: Send the image as the request body with its Content-Type. Served at `/api/v1/app/avatars/{userId}`, and `image` points there

requestBody.description: The image as the raw request body: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB (no SVG)

delete.description: `image` goes back to what the upload replaced (such as a social provider's image), or null

get.summary: Notifications I can turn off, and whether each is on
get.description: Billing mails, plus server alerts for staff. Sign-in codes, links and security notices are always sent

put.summary: Turn notifications on or off (only the keys sent change)

get.summary: Site name, description, images and currency (public)
Service health for uptime monitors (public)
get.description: D1 reachable and migrated, KV, R2 and queues bound. 503 when any check fails, and before the site is installed

get.summary: Enabled sign-in providers in display order (public, for rendering the sign-in page)
Captcha the frontend should show (public)
get.description: Send the token in the `x-captcha-response` header on the Better Auth endpoints of each listed scene. OTP password-reset requests require a token when either password_reset or send_code is enabled, including /email-otp/send-verification-otp with type forget-password. Other OTP requests follow send_code. Missing tokens get 400 MISSING_RESPONSE, rejected ones 403 VERIFICATION_FAILED, and 500 UNKNOWN_ERROR when the provider can't be reached

get.summary: The site's logo or link-preview image
get.description: Whether each is uploaded is in GET /api/v1/app/site

get.summary: Uploaded logo of a payment channel
get.description: The key is the channel id; the payment channel list gives `logoVersion` (add it as `?v=`) when one is uploaded

200.description: SVG, PNG, WebP or ICO image

get.summary: Uploaded logo of an OIDC sign-in provider
get.description: The key is the provider's `providerId` (as in the sign-in provider list)

200.description: SVG, PNG, WebP or ICO image

get.summary: Brand logo of a provider type (sign-in, email, SMS, payment)
get.description: The key is the provider `type` (github, resend, aliyun, stripe…). Generic types such as email_password, oidc or epay have none (404)

schema.description: Variant for dark backgrounds; the light one when there is none

parameters.description: Variant for dark backgrounds; the light one when there is none
parameters.name: theme

200.description: SVG, PNG, WebP or ICO image

502.description: Not stored yet and the source is unavailable

get.summary: Download a file
get.description: Public: anyone with the id can download it. Raster images, audio and video open in the browser; other types download under their original name

200.description: The file with the Content-Type it was uploaded with

get.summary: A user's uploaded avatar
get.description: Public. After an upload, `user.image` is this URL with `?v=` for cache busting. 404 when the user hasn't uploaded one (an image from a social provider stays in `user.image`)

schema.description: Version from `user.image`; a matching one is cached for good

parameters.description: Version from `user.image`; a matching one is cached for good
parameters.name: v

get.summary: A subscription's client config, picked by User-Agent or ?target (public)
get.description: Disabled or unknown tokens get 404, and every link 403 SUBSCRIPTION_LINK_DISABLED while subscriptions are app-only. The Subscription-Userinfo header carries usage, the limit and the expiry

200.description: Rendered subscription (403 when links are off, 404 for unknown or disabled tokens, 429 when rate limited)

get.summary: One of my subscriptions' client config, for the app (the same output as its link)
get.description: Sign in with a cookie or `Authorization: Bearer <set-auth-token>`. Takes the link's parameters (?target= picks a template). 403 SUBSCRIPTION_APP_DISABLED while subscriptions are link-only; 404 for disabled subscriptions and those of other users

200.description: Rendered subscription, with the same headers as its link

get.summary: Nodes one of my subscriptions gets, with their status (as in its subscription link)
get.description: Addresses and parameters aren't included: clients get them from the subscription link

patch.description: On: 1–2 days before it expires it is renewed from the balance, same plan and period as last time; without enough balance the user gets an email
